photo.prompt: four stylish women in a Brickell apartment getting ready before a Miami night out, one holding heels, one checking a rideshare app, one fixing lip gloss in a hallway mirror, skyline lights glowing through the window

slides.headline: You Change Shoes In The Elevator
slides.body:
Heels for the lobby. Backup pair in the tote.
Brickell has seen your whole strategy.

photo.prompt: a woman in a sleek black outfit changing from flats into heels inside a glossy Brickell condo elevator while her friends laugh and hold tiny purses, city lights reflecting in the mirror

slides.headline: You Ask The Group Chat For Final Approval
slides.body:
Three mirror pics, one “too much?” text.
Everyone replies late but you already knew.

photo.prompt: a woman posing in front of a full length mirror in a Miami apartment while her phone screen shows a busy group chat, friends in the background doing makeup under warm vanity lights

slides.headline: You Pack Like South Beach Is A Flight
slides.body:
Lip gloss, portable charger, ID, gum.
Your mini bag is doing a full weekend shift.

photo.prompt: close up of a tiny metallic purse on a South Beach hotel bed packed with lip gloss, portable charger, ID holder, gum, and sunglasses, neon pink club light spilling through the window

slides.headline: You Check NEAR Before Saying Yes
slides.body:
Wynwood, Brickell, or Beach?
You need to know who’s there before committing.

photo.prompt: three friends in a parked rideshare outside a Wynwood bar checking the NEAR app on one phone, colorful murals outside, blue and purple nightlife lighting on their faces

slides.headline: You Schedule Tomorrow Beach Like A Threat
slides.body:
It’s 12:18am and you’re already saying “early.”
Nobody believes you. Everyone agrees.

photo.prompt: a group of women outside a South Beach club at night laughing while one points at a phone calendar that says beach tomorrow, palm trees and club lights behind them

caption: tag the friend who starts getting ready three hours early and still makes the night better 💄
